emulator_policy.stocks: Manual gives no historical prices or formula. Shared quote starts100credits/share on first observation, rises1credit per elapsed UTC day; buy and sell use the same current quote. All quantities are integer. These are server economy rules, not reconstructed historical rates.
emulator_policy.bonds: Manual specifies a Gold purchase, a monthly sale window, a redemption day and carryover if missed. Reborn has no donated currency: bonds are bought for credits. Explicit schedule: sale days1..20 UTC, redemption day25, purchase150credits/unit, redemption initial150credits/unit rising5 each calendar month after first observation. Unredeemed bonds remain owned for the next month; no forced expiry.
emulator_policy.marks: Manual fee100credits per day and owner PIN removal/early return. PIN4..12digits and PBKDF2,365daylimit,5failed attempts/300second lock are policy. Dedicated owner-authorized lending bypasses ordinary marked-item market bans. Expiry returns the physical surviving item to owner warehouse, deferred while either account is in battle. Wear remains; destroyed items never respawn. Marks cannot be applied to stacks, currencies, rented/special items or boosters.
emulator_policy.payments: Gold retired; real-money currency purchases disabled. Donations are independent and award no game assets.
emulator_policy.wire: Stocks/bonds also use the recovered native C1 quotation-window ABI (SECURITIES_WINDOWS.md). Conversion and mark actions are server APIs/explicit emulator commands until original request ABI is recovered. ItemList30/WarehouseList6A ownername/remainingseconds projection uses the actual original readers; no new historical opcode is asserted.
